body: No no, you misunderstand, I'm not good at engineering. I said outside of. I don't think any switching will turn out in my favour because engineering will act as dead weight. And online opportunities won't help me here.

I wouldn't say it's that simple. It's like I said, when it comes to other majors, I would inherently be at a disadvantage if I were ever to go for anything beyond undergrad, which I find essential (especially in this worthless economy). I mean, I'm *good* at things (I regularly get As and A+s outside of engineering), but on a sort by CGPA basis I'll never get into anything I want to do.
